evals.prompt: 为 `{repo}` 设计一套 GitHub label taxonomy，并写入 `.github/labels.yml`。项目是 Node.js CLI，需要 type/status/priority/area 分类；保留 `good first issue`；不要创建同义标签。
evals.expected_output: A valid labels manifest defines a coherent taxonomy with type, status, priority, and area categories, unique names, valid colors and descriptions, and the exact good first issue label.
expectations: .github/labels.yml parses as a list of label objects
The taxonomy has type, status, priority, and area categories
At least 10 labels are defined with unique names
Every color is six hexadecimal digits and every description is 100 characters or fewer
The exact good first issue label is preserved
The taxonomy avoids synonyms such as bug/defect or enhancement/feature
NOTES.md explains the naming system and trade-offs

evals.prompt: 为 `{repo}` 写一个 GitHub Actions label 同步 workflow：PR 上 dry-run，main 上应用；使用 `.github/labels.yml`；权限最小化；action 固定到 SHA；初次上线不要删除未管理的 labels。
evals.expected_output: A label-sync workflow checks out the repository, uses the labeler action pinned to a SHA, grants issues write and contents read, dry-runs on pull requests, and keeps skip-delete enabled.
expectations: The workflow YAML parses
The workflow runs on changes to labels.yml and the workflow file
actions/checkout is present before the labeler
The labeler action is pinned to a 40-character commit SHA
The workflow grants issues: write and does not grant contents: write
dry-run is true on pull_request
skip-delete is true for the initial rollout
NOTES.md explains the rollout and permission choices

evals.prompt: `{repo}` 现在使用 `bug` label，issue 模板也引用 `bug`。把 label 改名为 `type: bug`，要求保留已有 issue 的 label 关联，并同步更新模板和 `.github/labels.yml`。
evals.expected_output: The manifest renames bug to type: bug with from_name, templates now reference type: bug, and no template still uses the old bare bug label.
expectations: .github/labels.yml contains type: bug with from_name: bug
Issue templates reference type: bug instead of the old bare bug label
No template still uses the exact old bug label
The rename preserves issue assignments by using from_name rather than delete/recreate
All YAML files parse and label names remain unique
NOTES.md explains the coordinated template and label change

evals.prompt: 审计 `{repo}` 的 labels 和 issue templates：找出模板引用但仓库不存在的 labels，修复 `.github/labels.yml` 和模板，并加一个 CI 检查防止再次不一致。
evals.expected_output: All template labels exist in the manifest after the fix, and a CI check validates template label references against .github/labels.yml without deleting unrelated labels.
expectations: The audit identifies the template labels missing from the manifest
Every template label now exists in .github/labels.yml
A CI workflow or script fails when a template references a missing label
The fix does not delete unrelated or unmanaged labels
All labels have valid colors and descriptions
All YAML files parse
NOTES.md explains the audit and the validation guard
